system.trigger: You are attacked, before you know whether the attack was successful.
system.description: Requirements You are not Grabbed or Restrained. Trigger You are targeted by a melee Attack of which you are aware. +2 Situation bonus to Evade against the triggering attack. If the Strike is a Graze or Miss, you may Move to any space adjacent to the attacker; moving through its space does not count as Difficult Terrain.
